There are no .install hooks, patches, or suspicious build steps. disagreement_analysis: The Qwen model experienced HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to audit .SRCINFO and LICENSE, leading to an 'inconclusive' verdict. The Deepseek model successfully audited all files and returned 'safe'. There is no actual security disagreement; the inconclusive result is an artifact of a transient API failure.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review .SRCINFO and LICENSE due to HTTP 400 API errors.
learnings: The audit tool should handle transient LLM API errors gracefully, perhaps by retrying or by not failing the entire audit if only non-executable metadata files (like LICENSE or .SRCINFO) fail to parse, provided the critical PKGBUILD is verified safe.
Ensure the tool correctly aggregates file verdicts without letting missing non-executable files force an inconclusive verdict when the PKGBUILD itself is clean and no other executable scripts exist.
